top_signals.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
top_signals.summary: Norway's Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet) has fined Microsoft-owned advertising company Xandr NOK 92 million ($9.6M) for unlawfully processing and sharing sensitive data belonging to Grindr users in the country. [...]
